name: Yohimbe bark extract
description: Yohimbe bark extract (CAS 85117-22-2 ), derived from the bark of the West African Pausinystalia yohimbe tree, is a standardized botanical extract commercially recognized by buyers as yohimbe extract or simply yohimbe. It is sourced primarily for its active alkaloid content, with yohimbine as the principal marker compound used to define extract potency and grade. Demand is concentrated in the dietary supplement and nutraceutical sectors. In sports nutrition and weight management supplements, yohimbe extract is incorporated into capsules, tablets, and powder blends where yohimbine concentration is the primary specification buyers evaluate. Pre-workout and thermogenic formulations use it as a functional botanical ingredient, often combined with stimulant or fat-metabolism stacks. Contract manufacturers require consistent alkaloid standardization. This standardization is typically expressed as a percentage of yohimbine to meet label claims and regulatory compliance. Pharmaceutical-grade extracts also enter compounding applications where precise quantification is required. Yohimbe bark extract is supplied as a dry powder, available in standardized grades ranging from 2% to 98% yohimbine content by HPLC. Both food-grade and pharmaceutical-grade specifications are available. Bulk supply is typically offered in kilogram quantities, with documentation including COA, heavy metal testing, and microbial analysis to support supplement manufacturing requirements and quality control.
